runtime.pixelMode: RGB; exact decoded pixel equality; no perceptual or registration tolerance
runtime.mupdfStorePolicy: clear global MuPDF store before every actual get_pixmap call

method.mixedAliasPolicy: When both complete dimension alias pairs are present, unequal values are rejected as conflicting; equal values are accepted only with an explicit equal-alias status. Partial mixed aliases are unsupported. Raw declaration objects remain verbatim in private row records.
method.pixelRule: Only exact decoded RGB channel equality passes; no approximate registration, resampling or similarity thresholds.
method.rendering: V4 isolated MuPDF-store policy and source-bound caches are retained; direct explicit source DPI remains available as a declared candidate, while generic full-page DPI search remains bounded at 432.
method.perRowEvidence: Private rows include original declarations, schema status, attempted recipes, pixel-comparison count, source/image identity hashes and owner-use joins. Unsupported/zero-attempt outcomes are separated from pixel-tested misses.
